School of Medicine Graduate Admissions
Congratulations on taking the next step in your biomedical career. As one of the world’s preeminent research institutions, we offer 29 programs in a range of concentrations. These programs are taught by an internationally recognized and award-winning faculty committed to developing the next generation of biomedical scientists. Our campus includes state-of-the-art facilities along with a wealth of historical resources, all in a vibrant yet charming urban setting.
The Johns Hopkins University does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, national or ethnic origin, disability, marital status, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics in any program or activity administered by the university, or with regard to admission or employment. Questions regarding Title IX, Title VI, and Section 504 should be referred to the Office of Institutional Equity, Wyman Park Building Suite 515, (410) 516-8075 - https://oie.jhu.edu/contact/
Connect with Us
To learn more about our graduate programs, please complete the form below. You will receive emails from the programs you are interested in, plus advice about completing our admissions applications. You may opt out of these emails at any time.

Vivien Thomas Ph.D. Scholars
The Vivien Thomas Scholars Initiative (VTSI) honors the legacy of Dr. Vivien Thomas, a pioneering scientist and surgical assistant whose work helped advance cardiac surgery at Johns Hopkins. The initiative expands pathways to Johns Hopkins STEM Ph.D. programs for talented students from a broad range of academic backgrounds and provides robust financial, mentoring, and professional development support. Please visit the VTSI program website for more information about the VTSI program.
